title: Fault injection: IPFS unavailable during ingestion
description:
Write an integration test that starts the transit store-and-forward pipeline with an IPFS mock that fails every write with IpfsNotReachable. Assert: (1) IHAVE returns a transient error code (400-series), not 200; (2) no article is added to the log; (3) no panic; (4) when IPFS is restored (mock re-enabled), subsequent IHAVE succeeds. Artifact: transit/tests/fault_ipfs_unavailable.rs.

Acceptance criteria:
- All four assertions pass
- Test is deterministic
- Test completes in under 10 seconds
